summary.text: Becky Edwards is a Democratic member of the Montana House of Representatives who currently represents District 61 and is the Democratic candidate for District 57 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Republican Bob Crank is also running.
Her career experience includes being a small business owner and executive director of a national conservation organization.

paragraphs.text: Edwards' career experience includes being a small business owner and working as the executive director of a national conservation organization.
She won the 2024 general election for the open District 61 seat, defeating Thomas Carlson, 71.4 percent to 28.6 percent.
In the 2025-2026 session Edwards was assigned to the House State Administration, Natural Resources and Legislative Administration committees.
In 2026 she also sought the Democratic nomination for Montana State Senate District 32 and lost in the June 2, 2026 primary, and she did not appear on the primary ballot for District 61.
